function.name: debugstr_user_flags
function.description: This function returns a string representation of user flags. It uses a switch statement to determine the string representation of the lower word of the flags. It then checks the higher word of the flags to determine the final return string.

parameters.name: pFlags
parameters.description: A pointer to user flags

function.return_type: char: A string representation of user flags

function.name: handle_UserSize
function.description: This function handles the size of the user by checking if the low word of the flag is equal to MSHCTX_DIFFERENTMACHINE. If it is, an error is raised and the function returns the starting size. If not, the starting size is aligned to the length of 3 and the size of RemotableHandle is added to it.

parameters.name: pFlags
parameters.description: Pointer to a flag that is checked against MSHCTX_DIFFERENTMACHINE

parameters.name: StartingSize
parameters.description: The initial size that is returned or adjusted based on the flag

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Pointer to a handle that is not directly used in this function

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the final calculated size

function.name: handle_UserMarshal
function.description: This function handles the marshalling of user data. It checks if the data is from a different machine, raises an exception if it is, aligns the buffer pointer, sets the context and inproc handle, and returns the buffer pointer incremented by the size of the RemotableHandle.

parameters.name: pFlags
parameters.description: Pointer to flags that determine the context of the call

parameters.name: pBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the RemotableHandle is stored

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Pointer to the handle that is being marshalled

function.return_type: unsigned char*, represents the buffer pointer incremented by the size of the RemotableHandle

function.name: handle_UserUnmarshal
function.description: This function aligns the pointer to the buffer, checks if the remote handle context is not an in-process call, raises an exception if it is, assigns the in-process handle to the handle pointer, and returns the buffer pointer incremented by the size of the RemotableHandle.

parameters.name: pFlags
parameters.description: Pointer to flags, not used in this function

parameters.name: pBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that is cast to a RemotableHandle and used to check the context and retrieve the in-process handle

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Pointer to a handle that is assigned the in-process handle from the RemotableHandle

function.return_type: unsigned char*; returns the buffer pointer incremented by the size of the RemotableHandle

function.name: handle_UserFree
function.description: This function currently does not perform any operation.

parameters.name: pFlags
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG variable

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Pointer to a HANDLE variable

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: CLIPFORMAT_UserSize
function.description: Calculates the buffer size required to marshal a clip format.

parameters.name: pFlags
parameters.description: Pointer to flags. Even though the function is documented to take a pointer to an unsigned long, it actually takes a pointer to a USER_MARSHAL_CB structure, of which the first parameter is an unsigned long.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Starting size of the buffer. This value is added on to the buffer size required for the clip format.

parameters.name: pCF
parameters.description: Clip format to size.

function.return_type: ULONG. The buffer size required to marshal a clip format plus the starting size.

function.name: CLIPFORMAT_UserMarshal
function.description: This function marshals the CLIPFORMAT data for remote or in-process calls. It checks if the CLIPFORMAT is a pre-defined type and if the call is going remote. If so, it gets the clipboard format name and raises an exception if the length is zero. It then copies the format name into the buffer. If the call is not going remote, it simply sets the buffer for an in-process call.

parameters.name: pFlags
parameters.description: Pointer to the flags used to determine the type of marshalling required

parameters.name: pBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the marshalled data will be stored

parameters.name: pCF
parameters.description: Pointer to the CLIPFORMAT that needs to be marshalled

function.return_type: unsigned char* representing the updated buffer after marshalling

function.name: CLIPFORMAT_UserUnmarshal
function.description: This function unmarshals a CLIPFORMAT object from a buffer. It handles different contexts of the unmarshaling process, raising exceptions for invalid bounds and tags.

parameters.name: pFlags
parameters.description: Pointer to user flags

parameters.name: pBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer from which the CLIPFORMAT object is unmarshaled

parameters.name: pCF
parameters.description: Pointer to the CLIPFORMAT object that is unmarshaled

function.return_type: unsigned char*, represents the updated position in the buffer after unmarshaling

function.name: CLIPFORMAT_UserFree
function.description: This function does not perform any operation as there is no inverse of the RegisterClipboardFormat function.

parameters.name: pFlags
parameters.description: Pointer to a ULONG variable.

parameters.name: pCF
parameters.description: Pointer to a CLIPFORMAT variable.

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return anything.

function.name: HBITMAP_UserSize
function.description: This function calculates the size of the user object for a bitmap handle. It aligns the size to the nearest multiple of 3, then adds the size of ULONG. Depending on the flags, it may add additional sizes.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Pointer to flags that determine how the size is calculated

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Initial size value

parameters.name: bmp
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap handle

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the calculated size of the user object for the bitmap handle

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the marshalled data is stored.

parameters.name: bmp

function.return_type: unsigned char *; Returns a pointer to the buffer after the bitmap handle has been marshalled into it.
